import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from scipy.sparse import diags
from scipy.sparse.linalg import spsolve
df = pd.read_csv('spectrum.csv'); x=df.shift_cm1.values; y=df.intensity.values
def als(y, lam=1e5, p=0.001, niter=20):
    L=len(y); D=diags([1,-2,1],[0,-1,-2],shape=(L,L-2))
    w=np.ones(L)
    for _ in range(niter):
        W=diags(w,0); Z=W+lam*D.dot(D.T)
        z=spsolve(Z.tocsc(), w*y)
        w=p*(y>z)+(1-p)*(y<z)
    return z
b = als(y)
r = y-b
np.save('/dev/null', b) if False else None
print("baseline range", b.min().round(1), b.max().round(1))
# noise estimate from residual in featureless regions
noise = np.std(np.diff(r[(x>700)&(x<850)]))/np.sqrt(2)
print("noise est", round(noise,2))
pk,props = find_peaks(r, prominence=6*noise, width=2)
print("n peaks", len(pk))
for i,p in enumerate(pk):
    print(f"{x[p]:8.2f}  height={r[p]:8.1f}  prom={props['prominences'][i]:8.1f}  width_pts={props['widths'][i]:.1f}")

There is no G band near 1580 cm⁻¹, no 2D band near 2700 cm⁻¹, and no feature near 1366 cm⁻¹. Next I'll fit the two sharp lines with pseudo-Voigt profiles on a polynomial background to get centres, widths and uncertainties.

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from lmfit import Model
from lmfit.models import PseudoVoigtModel, PolynomialModel
df = pd.read_csv('spectrum.csv'); x=df.shift_cm1.values; y=df.intensity.values
# fit windows around the two sharp lines, background = quadratic over local window
def fit_window(lo,hi,center0,label):
    m=(x>=lo)&(x<=hi); xx=x[m]; yy=y[m]
    mod = PseudoVoigtModel(prefix='p_') + PolynomialModel(degree=2, prefix='b_')
    pars = mod.make_params()
    pars['p_center'].set(value=center0, min=center0-5, max=center0+5)
    pars['p_amplitude'].set(value=yy.max()*0.6)
    pars['p_sigma'].set(value=2.0, min=0.3, max=10)
    pars['p_fraction'].set(value=0.5, min=0, max=1)
    pars['b_c0'].set(value=yy.min())
    pars['b_c1'].set(value=0); pars['b_c2'].set(value=0)
    r = mod.fit(yy, pars, x=xx)
    s = r.params
    fwhm = 2*s['p_sigma'].value  # lmfit pseudo-voigt sigma is HWHM for lorentz part
    print(f"== {label}  window {lo}-{hi}, N={len(xx)}, redchi={r.redchi:.1f}")
    print(f"   center = {s['p_center'].value:.2f} +/- {s['p_center'].stderr:.2f} cm-1")
    print(f"   sigma (HWHM-like) = {s['p_sigma'].value:.2f} +/- {s['p_sigma'].stderr:.2f}; FWHM (approx) = {s['p_fwhm'].value:.2f} cm-1" if 'p_fwhm' in s else f"   sigma={s['p_sigma'].value:.2f}")
    print(f"   fraction (Lorentz) = {s['p_fraction'].value:.2f};  amplitude = {s['p_amplitude'].value:.1f} +/- {s['p_amplitude'].stderr:.1f}")
    print(f"   peak height above background = {r.eval_components(x=xx)['p_']. max():.1f}")
    return r
r1=fit_window(505,540,520.6,'Si line')
r2=fit_window(1380,1415,1396.5,'1396 line')
res = y[(x>=1380)&(x<=1415)] - r2.best_fit
print("residual rms near 1396:", round(np.std(res),1))
EOF

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from lmfit.models import LorentzianModel, LinearModel, GaussianModel
df = pd.read_csv('spectrum.csv'); x=df.shift_cm1.values; y=df.intensity.values
def lor_fit(lo,hi,c0,label):
    m=(x>=lo)&(x<=hi); xx=x[m]; yy=y[m]
    mod=LorentzianModel(prefix='l_')+LinearModel(prefix='b_')
    p=mod.make_params(l_center=c0,l_sigma=2,l_amplitude=(yy.max()-yy.min())*np.pi*2,b_slope=0,b_intercept=yy.min())
    p['l_center'].set(min=c0-4,max=c0+4)
    r=mod.fit(yy,p,x=xx)
    s=r.params
    print(f"{label}: Lorentz center={s['l_center'].value:.2f}+/-{s['l_center'].stderr:.2f}, FWHM={2*s['l_sigma'].value:.2f}+/-{2*s['l_sigma'].stderr:.2f}, redchi={r.redchi:.0f}")
    return r
lor_fit(505,540,520.6,'Si   ')
lor_fit(1380,1415,1396.5,'1396 ')
# direct FWHM from raw data (linear baseline from flanks)
for lo,hi,c,lab in [(505,540,520.66,'Si'),(1380,1415,1396.48,'1396')]:
    m=(x>=lo)&(x<=hi); xx=x[m]; yy=y[m]
    base = np.interp(c, [lo,hi],[yy[:3].mean(), yy[-3:].mean()])
    pk = yy.max()
    half = base + (pk-base)/2
    i=np.argmax(yy)
    # left crossing
    j=i
    while j>0 and yy[j]>half: j-=1
    xl = xx[j]+(half-yy[j])*(xx[j+1]-xx[j])/(yy[j+1]-yy[j])
    k=i
    while k<len(yy)-1 and yy[k]>half: k+=1
    xr = xx[k-1]+(half-yy[k-1])*(xx[k]-xx[k-1])/(yy[k]-yy[k-1])
    print(f"{lab} direct FWHM (raw, linear base): {xr-xl:.2f} cm-1  (half-max {xl:.2f} to {xr:.2f})")

m=(x>1100)&(x<1200)
loc = y[m]; print("1100-1200 local mean/std:", loc.mean().round(0), loc.std().round(0))
i=np.argmax(y*(x>1150)*(x<1165)); print("1157 point:", x[i], y[i])
# local noise from point-to-point scatter in 1000-1100 region
print("point-to-point std 1000-1100:", np.std(np.diff(y[(x>1000)&(x<1100)]))/np.sqrt(2))
